accepted_claims: The provider-neutral endpoint, event-ingress and call-session slice compiles and passes PHPStan level 8 at the exact tested revision.
Fake, independently packaged demo and in-package Asterisk AMI fixtures pass the same unchanged fourteen public conformance cases.
The Asterisk AMI fixture profile maps four documented actions and keeps answer, hold and resume unsupported.
Duplicate and reordered events produce one logical call timeline without reopening terminal state.
Rejected provider responses are failed and timeout, disconnect, transport exception and correlation uncertainty are never success.
Canonical events and evidence retain hashes and Larena identities rather than raw provider payload, channel, number or secret values.
The implementation introduces no network transport, persistence, migration, private dependency or entitlement coupling.
notes: Asterisk behavior is demonstrated by sanitized offline fixtures only; no PBX interoperability test was performed.
The independently packaged demo adapter remains maintained in the same repository and is not an external vendor acceptance.
Service-provider discovery is a package-level composition check, not a root Larena application run.
blockers: No independent product or application reviewer has accepted this batch.
The package is not composed into the aggregate workspace or root Larena application.
No live PBX, credential, network transport, release or production evidence exists.
AI voice, media, recording, transcription, CRM and remote connector scopes remain closed.
